items.description: Keep the prior index intact when replacing the specle skill fails.
evidence: src/specle/inventory.py:218 locates index.json inside the specle skill directory.
src/specle/inventory.py:255-262 replaces every staged skill before the index.
src/specle/inventory.py:305-309 deletes an existing skill directory before renaming its staged replacement.
items.analysis: During `init --force`, replacing the managed specle skill deletes its directory and therefore its existing index before the final index move. If that skill replacement, a later steering replacement, or the final index move fails, the previous index has already been lost. This contradicts the bugfix contract and the CLI-init design's index-last guarantee.
items.recommendation: Stage the generated index so the prior specle directory is not removed until a replacement strategy can preserve the old index, or restructure installation so the index is independently replaceable without deleting its containing skill directory. Add a regression test that injects a failure while replacing specle and asserts the prior index remains available.
items.decision_rationale: Preserving the previous index through every pre-index failure is part of the bugfix contract and the CLI-init design.

dispatch.reason: The abbreviated bugfix contract and test-first plan now require resource-preserving transactional replacement for every managed skill.

items.description: Retain a backup when rollback cannot restore it.
evidence: src/specle/inventory.py:266-272 restores backups after a replacement failure, then passes every backup to generic cleanup.
src/specle/inventory.py:327-338 suppresses restore failures and leaves an unrestored backup in place.
src/specle/inventory.py:341-352 can then delete that backup.
items.analysis: If restoration of a prior skill directory fails, its backup is the only remaining recoverable copy. The unconditional post-rollback cleanup treats it as disposable and may delete it, violating the transactional contract's resource-preservation guarantee.
items.recommendation: Have rollback report which backups were restored successfully. Clean only successfully restored backups; retain any unrestored backup and include its path in the raised installation error for manual recovery. Add a regression test that injects a rollback failure.
items.decision_rationale: An unrestored backup is the last recoverable copy of managed resources and must not be removed.

dispatch.reason: The bugfix contract and regression plan now require preserving and reporting an unrestored backup.
